text: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawangawangisa nje.
Impahla iza koma phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.
Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci unamacebo awo angeCawa.
Isanti iwela indlela ukhozo ngokhozo. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.
Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zizithathela indawo.
Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owa uvela esibhakabhakeni.
Ilaphu letafile li-ayiniwe kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungalimbi. Kugqibelele.
Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iimpahla ezine nomoya omhle.
Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza koma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.
Ababaleki bango-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.
Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Thina asinakutsho njalo.
Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.
Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali.
Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
Okunsomi phansi, okumhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamukelwe.
Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zizibambele.
Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: iqhugwane, umlilo, kuphelile.
Amafu ambozile izulu, kodwa ngomzamo omncane.
Sekuphakathi nendlela ukuya esiphephweni sokuduma kwezulu saseHighveld. Noma cha.
Amafu anele ukuthi uphawule ngawo, ilanga lanele ukuthi ungawanaki.
